study type: Case-control study and experimental animal study
cohort: The human cohort included preeclampsia patients, healthy volunteers, and control patients who had undergone an elective Cesarean section, and the animal cohort consisted of rat models of preeclampsia.
finding: The study found that Yin Yang 1 (YY1) regulates the balance of T(reg)/T(H)17 cells and affects the preeclampsia process, in part through activation of the PI3K/AKT pathway.
